description:
MCP guidance:
- Starts an async audio job; returns `id` and `credits_charged`. For finished results, call `wait_for_audio_project` with that id or poll `GET /v1/audio-projects/{id}` until `complete`, `error`, or `canceled`. Results include `downloads`; wait helpers add `exact_download_urls`. Preserve signed URLs and query parameters; never append expiration metadata.

Generate music from a description, with optional custom lyrics or instrumental-only output. Costs 1 credits per requested second. Returns a project ID; poll GET /v1/audio-projects/{id} for status and downloads.

duration.description: Requested track duration in seconds, from 15 to 300. Determines credits charged.

name.description: Give your audio a custom name for easy identification.

instrumental.description: Generate music without vocals. When true, lyrics is ignored.

lyrics.description: Custom lyrics. Omit or leave blank for AI-generated lyrics when instrumental is false.

prompt.description: Describe the song, including genre, mood, and instruments.
prompt.example: Dreamy synthwave with warm bass and soft vocals

name: ai_music_generator_create_audio

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the audio. We charge credits right when the request is made. 

If an error occurred while generating the audio, credits will be refunded and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the audio. Use it with the [Get audio Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/audio-projects/get-audio-details) to fetch status and downloads.

title: AI Music Generator
